definition.divergent: a differential workload ran and at least one operation did NOT match native Node
definition.unverified: no differential workload exists — compile/validation only; correctness is UNKNOWN, not confirmed

correctness.oracle: native Node executing the same pinned package, computed at run time; never read from a committed pin

inputModes.compile-time-static: package, test driver, and fixed inputs are visible to the Wasm compiler
inputModes.runtime-dynamic: an input or input-selecting value is supplied by the JavaScript host only after Wasm compilation
